senses.gloss:
√sidh1 'repel'
present: [1.] sédhati etc. V.+ sédhate etc. S.+ 
perfect: siṣedha etc. V.+ siṣidhe 
aorist: [1.] asedhi -- [3.] asīṣidhat -- [4.] asaitsīt -- [5.] asedhīs etc. 
future: [1.] setsyati sedhiṣyati -- [2.] seddhā sedhitā 
verbal: siddha B.+ sedhum B.+ -sídhya AV.+ 
secondary: passive: sidhyate etc. E.+ -- intensive: séṣidhat -- desiderative: sisedhiṣa- sisidhiṣa- siṣitsa- -- causative: sedhayati etc. S.+ 
derivatives: sedha AV.+ -sedhaka E.+ -sedhin C. -sedhya C. -sedhana E.+ -sedhanīya C. -siddhi C. -seddhavya E.+ -seddhṛ B.+ -seddhra B. sidhmá B.+ sidhman? B.+ -sedhayitṛ C. 
See the following root.

√sidh2 'succeed'
present: [4.] sídhyati etc. sídhyate etc. E.+ 
perfect: siṣedha 
aorist: [1.] sidhyāsam asedhi -- [2.] asidhat -- [3.] asīṣidhat -- [4.] saitait 
future: [1.] setsyati setsyate etc. E.+ -- [2.] seddhā 
verbal: siddha sedhitvā sidhitvā siddhvā 
[secondary: seṣidh- siṣitsa- sedhaya- ]
derivatives: -sidh siddhi U.+ sidhmá RV. sidhrá RV. -sídhvan RV. 
Appears to be a weakened form of √sādh. Grassmann, however, considers 1sidh and 2sidh as one root, and there are in fact some difficulties in their separation.
